svg.title: CRAFT: decompose, verify, and learn from reusable clauses
svg.desc: Panel A: target-hidden rollouts are decomposed into clauses, pooled, filtered, composed, and verified. Panel B: the same verified clauses supervise SFT distillation and RL credit assignment via a shared target-free scorer.
svg.text: decompose within each rollout · compose across rollouts
one failed clause leaves the others intact
the same verified clauses supervise both learning stages
each surviving clause credits its proposers
